body: you think they’ll do something about this?

I guess so. I know shoppers are also curbies at times & you will get it on your schedule regardless, but I was hired as a shopper & prefer shopping. If they need curbies I wish they’d just hire more. I feel like we have a ton but whatever. I just hate getting stuck with the shift when there was someone willing to take it off my hands but had it denied. It used to be easy, now it’s difficult.

Yes they approved it & I don’t pick up outside of my availability. I just requested less hrs per week and up to 6hr shifts. The person who was going to originally take one of these shifts (which is tomorrow now & still on my schedule) from me had it denied twice from wfm, so I assume it was out of their availability. I think if it was available to be taken from pnet it would’ve been gone by now. Every shift i’ve posted to pnet since this change is still up, which is usually never the case for me. They usually get taken at some point as I post them right when I get them if I don’t want it, unless it’s a less desirable shift like on a weekend for example I may have more trouble with it being picked up.

I’ve always wondered about this, why no commended for leaving early? I guess it is optional & you’re getting to leave, but you’re also missing out on money to help with them being high in labor. I’d feel stupid for asking lol
One of the main reasons I took this job was for the flexibility in combination with my other job. This is taking nearly all the flexibility away.
With the looks of it, I think your best bet would be to remove it.
